map.逐项判定：导热系数≤0.06 W/m·K（GB/T 10294）、阻燃等级≤2: Item by item: thermal conductivity ≤0.06 W/m·K (GB/T 10294), flame retardancy grade ≤2, i.e. B1 or above (GB 8624), environmental compliance rate ≥90% (GB 18580); all three must be met to conform, otherwise rectify and retest. A report may be used for acceptance only when all pass.
map.按导热系数、阻燃等级、环保达标率三项指标判定保温材料是否合格: Judge insulation material conformance from three indicators: thermal conductivity, flame retardancy grade and environmental compliance rate

map.阈值分别引自 GB/T 10294、GB 8624、GB 18580: Thresholds are quoted from GB/T 10294, GB 8624 and GB 18580 respectively
map.进场验收：按导热系数、阻燃等级、环保达标率判定是否合格: Entry acceptance: judge conformance from thermal conductivity, flame retardancy grade and environmental compliance rate

map.规范提示：阈值引自 GB/T 10294、GB 8624、GB 18580: Standards note: thresholds are quoted from GB/T 10294, GB 8624 and GB 18580

map.点击判定，查看三项结论与综合合格性: Click to judge and see the three conclusions and overall conformance

map.阻燃等级数字越小越好（1=A 不燃、2=B1 难燃、3=B2 可燃、4=B3 易: The smaller the flame retardancy number the better (1=A non-combustible, 2=B1 flame-retardant, 3=B2 combustible, 4=B3 flammable); ≤2 passes
map.B3 易燃严禁用于建筑保温: B3 flammable — strictly forbidden for building insulation
map.三项合格仅代表进场自检符合所列阈值，完整验收还含燃烧分级、耐久性与系统构造: Passing all three items only means the incoming self-check meets the listed thresholds; full acceptance also covers fire grading, durability and system construction
map.结果仅作快速初筛，须以正式检测报告与设计要求为准: Results serve only as a quick first screen; the formal test report and design requirements govern
map.阻燃等级数字越小越好？: Is a smaller flame retardancy number better?
map.是的，本工具取 1=A 不燃、2=B1 难燃、3=B2 可燃、4=B3 易燃，≤: Yes. This tool takes 1=A non-combustible, 2=B1 flame-retardant, 3=B2 combustible, 4=B3 flammable, and ≤2 means B1 or above passes; grade A non-combustible is best, and B3 flammable is strictly forbidden for building insulation.
map.三项都合格就绝对安全？: Does passing all three mean it is absolutely safe?
map.仅代表进场自检符合所列三项阈值；完整验收还含燃烧性能分级、耐久性、系统构造等，须: Only indicates that the incoming self-check meets the three listed thresholds; full acceptance also covers fire performance grading, durability and system construction, and must follow the formal test report and design requirements — this tool is a quick first screen.
